policy: Frozen research only. Candidates, including high confidence, are not confirmed until independently reviewed and integrated into the catalog.

proposals.summary: Returns without reading or changing state.

evidence.detail: Empty void function body.
Called among scene shutdown/reset helpers before transition synchronization.

open_questions: Whether this empty hook has a more specific intended subsystem cannot be recovered from its body.

proposals.summary: Returns the constant 3, which a coordinated-attack damage path compares against 6.

evidence.detail: Unconditionally returns 3.
Case 6 checks this result against 6 to choose zero damage versus the normal damage calculation.

open_questions: What semantic quantity does the constant 3 represent? No mutable state or other callers identify the intended quantity.

proposals.summary: Requests the background random blend task to hold its third blend state and eventually report state 2.

evidence.detail: Stores request value 1 in the hold/status byte.
In blend state 2 a nonzero request prevents the normal transition and is changed to 2 when the counter reaches 13.
The presentation requests this hold before entering its final waiting state.

proposals.summary: Returns the background random blend hold handshake byte without changing it.

evidence.detail: Returns gUnk_03000275.
Background task consumes a nonzero request and changes it to 2 at counter 13.
Presentation waits for this accessor to return 2 before exiting.

proposals.summary: Enables progression from the initial random background blend state.

evidence.detail: Sets cycling control byte gUnk_03000274 to 1.
Background task remains in state 0 while this byte is zero; with it set the counter may advance to state 1.
Presentation enables progression during its repeated sprite-effect phase.

proposals.summary: Allocates an 0x800-byte stack and schedules the coordinated attack presentation dispatcher with a signed byte index and packed signed byte arguments.

evidence.detail: Installs dispatcher 923B4 in fixed task control 030001E8.
Retries stack allocation with signal waits until nonnull, then initializes stack top and priority 0x40.
Schedules the task with byte index and packed arguments.
Coordinated attack flow starts presentation and waits for completion signal 0x12001111.

proposals.summary: Calls indexed setup and animation callbacks with two unpacked signed bytes, then signals coordinated attack presentation completion.

evidence.detail: Converts signed low byte of index to a four-byte callback-table offset.
Extracts signed high and low parameter bytes.
Calls setup callback and line 1947 calls matching animation callback.
Wakes completion signal 0x12001111.
Coordinated attack caller waits for that exact signal.

proposals.summary: Clears sound-test animation state, installs nine animation callbacks, and initializes the fixed animation task control without scheduling it.

evidence.detail: Clears shared animation heap pointer.
Begins assigning nine callbacks through line 1830.
Initializes task fields and priority 0x3C through line 1834.
Sound test menu calls this initializer.

proposals.summary: Selects one of nine sound-test animation callbacks using RNG, allocates its stack and schedules the fixed task.

evidence.detail: Chooses absolute signed random remainder modulo nine.
Stores selected callback into task control.
Allocates 0x400-byte stack and line 1847 schedules task.
Sound test invokes it while playing and shared animation heap is zero.

proposals.summary: Computes the BG1 horizontal scroll DMA source from scanline, sine phase and amplitude, or zeroes it outside visible scanlines.

evidence.detail: Reads current scanline from VCOUNT.
On scanlines 0..159 writes sine-table value times amplitude shifted by eight into DMA source halfword.
Uses zero outside visible scanlines.
DMA source is this halfword and line 296 targets BG1HOFS at 04000014.

proposals.summary: Configures a display with sprites enabled and backgrounds disabled, installs rendering overrides, resets BG scroll and blend state, and clears the first backdrop palette entry.

evidence.detail: Sets display mode and clears BG enables before enabling OBJ with 0x1000 on line 1777.
Installs three rendering overrides with value 1 through line 1780.
Zeroes BG0/BG1 scroll halfwords through line 1784, disables blend and zeroes palette entry zero.
Registers this as setup callback 6 paired with 95AD8 in coordinated attack dispatcher.

proposals.summary: Fades tracked audio, runs the counted sprite presentation, then disables the three rendering overrides.

evidence.detail: Requests audio fade with argument 3.
Runs 9561C using the signed-byte argument.
Disables all three presentation rendering overrides through line 1795.
Callee caps count at 20, allocates counted sprite state and animates resources 50046/50047.
Registers as coordinated attack presentation animation callback 6.

proposals.summary: Allocates shared sound-test animation storage, yields through a short state sequence and 61-count delay, then frees the storage unless externally cleared.

evidence.detail: Allocates 0x110 bytes and publishes pointer in the same global used by sound-test animation tasks.
Advances states 0 to 1 to 2 to 6, then counts to 61; yields each iteration.
Stops if state reaches 255 or external code clears shared pointer.
Frees and clears shared pointer if still nonzero.
Sound test uses that shared pointer to gate new animation starts.

open_questions: No direct caller or callback registration for this apparently unused routine is present in source; its intended visual effect is unproven.

proposals.summary: Locks the local event, clears enemy tasks, performs a closing display transition, starts 23 timed scene messages, then requests a parent-controlled scene exit and waits for exit or link error.

evidence.detail: Begins local player event and stops enemy tasks on line 145.
Repeatedly advances B6068 window closure until its low-byte result is nonzero.
Starts scene messages 0x483 through 0x499 with limit 0x1A4 and waits 0x1A7 between them unless link error.
Parent or loopback queues scene exit, then line 155 waits for exit flag or link error.
B6068 updates window bounds and reports done after tick exceeds 119.

proposals.summary: Initializes an uninitialized scene; on its exit flag, requests window hide and map-task stop, selects the current area record from map-set 12, clears initialization state and sets scene field +0x36 to 6 and returns 1; otherwise returns 0. Initialization also sets the map height bound halfword to 30.

evidence.detail: Checks scene initialization halfword +0x10 and calls the common initializer when zero.
After exit-flag check and transition wait, selects gUnk_0850DE28[scene word +0x40] into record pointer +0x71C.
Destination-selector case 12 chooses the same table, establishing map-set identity without assigning a place name.
Exit predicate tests scene flags halfword +4 bit 4.
Scene initializer consumes +0x71C as typed scene records, including records that queue object spawns.
Initial path writes map height bound at +0x72 to 30; map-update consumer uses this value to clamp vertical tile position.
Map update clamps vertical tile position to map halfword +0x72 minus 20, proving a spatial bound rather than delay.

proposals.summary: Initializes the scene or, after an exit request, selects map-set 0 area 2, clears exit and encounter state, resets the local player state and marks scene continuation fields.

evidence.detail: Initializes only when scene +0x10 is zero; otherwise waits for scene exit predicate.
Selects destination (0,2), clears exit flag and clears scene encounter-active flag.
Sets +0x36 to 1 and ORs mask 0x40000 into scene word +0x74.
Clears local player flag mask 2 and state +0x20, then sets scene +0x30/+0x24 to 1.
Destination selector clears initialization and stores area +0x40/map-set +0, establishing destination semantics.

open_questions: The independent gameplay meaning of scene word +0x74 mask 0x40000 and continuation halfwords +0x24/+0x30 is not yet proven; proposed name claims only destination handling.
